verdict: Paid ads are paused; organic reach is slipping and needs attention now.
narrative: This period, both Meta and Google Ads carried zero spend and delivered zero leads — the paid channels have been fully paused for the entire 28-day window. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile generated 221 actions (including 69 calls and 91 direction requests), but that activity dropped 50% in the most recent week, and search visibility fell 52% over the same stretch, leaving no paid backstop to catch the decline. Website traffic is reaching the site — 312 sessions from 253 visitors — but conversion tracking is being repaired, so the contact and appointment numbers currently under-report actual activity. This week, we're completing attribution cleanup and restoring the dashboard so the full picture of your intake pipeline is visible and verifiable ahead of the renewal decision.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions this period, including 69 calls and 91 direction requests
Drop in Google Business Profile actions in the most recent week versus the prior week
Website sessions this period with conversion tracking repair in progress

watch_item.issue: The intake pipeline — opportunities, appointments, and attribution — cannot be fully verified while tracking gaps remain open, and the August scoreboard needed for your renewal decision is not yet confirmed.
